description_for_human: Reads pull requests, issues, commits, and search results from GitHub via the GitHub Remote MCP Server (OAuth-protected).

functions.name: get_commit
functions.description: Get details for a commit from a GitHub repository

functions.name: get_file_contents
functions.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository

functions.name: get_me
functions.description: Get details of the authenticated GitHub user. Use this when a request is about the user's own profile for GitHub. Or when information is missing to build other tool calls.

functions.name: issue_read
functions.description: Get information about a specific issue in a GitHub repository.

functions.name: list_commits
functions.description: Get list of commits of a branch in a GitHub repository. Returns at least 30 results per page by default, but can return more if specified using the perPage parameter (up to 100).

functions.name: list_issues
functions.description: List issues in a GitHub repository. For pagination, use the 'endCursor' from the previous response's 'pageInfo' in the 'after' parameter.

functions.name: list_pull_requests
functions.description: List pull requests in a GitHub repository. If the user specifies an author, then DO NOT use this tool and use the search_pull_requests tool instead.

functions.name: pull_request_read
functions.description: Get information on a specific pull request in GitHub repository.

functions.name: search_code
functions.description: Fast and precise code search across ALL GitHub repositories using GitHub's native search engine. Best for finding exact symbols, functions, classes, or specific code patterns.

functions.name: search_commits
functions.description: Search for commits across GitHub repositories using GitHub's commit search syntax. Useful for finding specific changes, authors, or messages across one or many repositories. Searches the default branch only.

functions.name: search_issues
functions.description: Search for issues in GitHub repositories using issues search syntax already scoped to is:issue

functions.name: search_pull_requests
functions.description: Search for pull requests in GitHub repositories using issues search syntax already scoped to is:pr

functions.name: search_repositories
functions.description: Find GitHub repositories by name, description, readme, topics, or other metadata. Perfect for discovering projects, finding examples, or locating specific repositories across GitHub.

functions.name: search_users
functions.description: Find GitHub users by username, real name, or other profile information. Useful for locating developers, contributors, or team members.

description_for_model: Plugin that delegates engineering-intelligence queries to GitHub's hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/. Use this plugin whenever a user asks anything about pull requests, issues, commits, code search, repositories, or GitHub users. The plugin runs strictly within the signed-in user's GitHub OAuth scope (repo, user). Always call get_me once at the start of a session if the user's GitHub login is not already known. For activity questions, prefer search_pull_requests and search_issues with GitHub search qualifiers (e.g. is:pr author:@me state:open updated:>YYYY-MM-DD). For depth on a specific pull request (reviews, status checks, comments) call pull_request_read.
